title: allthings/react native
content:
When

Tue Nov 4, 2025

5:00–8:30 PM, San Francisco time

271 went.

About

Join us at Discord HQ for All Things React Native - hang out with the mobile and web dev community, enjoy two exciting tech talks, and let's dive deep into React Native.

**Talks & Speakers**

*   **Discord's New Arch Journey** \_w/ Alex Hendrix (\_Sr Software Eng @ Discord)
*   **Nitro Modules** \_w/ Marc Rousavy (\_CEO @ Margelo)
*   **I’m Evan Bacon** w/ Evan Bacon (cr@kt engineer @ Expo)

**Schedule**

*   **5:00 – 6:00 PM**: Doors open! Grab a snack, enjoy a drink, and meet fellow attendees.
*   **6:00 – 7:00 PM**: Time for tech talks!
*   **7:00 – 8:00 PM**: Stick around to chat, connect, and dive deeper into all things web discussions.

Lois and Toma (YC W24) are organizing an after-party at their HQ in SF! If you want to hang out after the All Things Web meetup, [RSVP here for the afterparty](https://luma.com/y10jy1ka)!

**About All Things Web**

We are a group of web enthusiasts who love to bring the community together and chat about all things web! Subscribe to [our Luma calendar](https://lu.ma/allthingsweb) for upcoming events, visit [allthingsweb.dev](http://allthingsweb.dev) to learn more, and [join our Discord](https://discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD) server to stay connected.

On stage

## Discord's New Arch Journey

Exploring Discord's journey with their new architecture and how it impacts the platform.

![](/img/72x72/jpeg/1791104439/profiles/alex-hendrix-c843972d-a7b1-4b0a-8a19-8481ff2aa02a.png)

Senior Software Engineer at Discord with experience building scalable systems. Previously worked at ONENIGMA and Microsoft.

## Nitro Modules

An introduction to Nitro Modules and how they work in React Native.

![](/img/72x72/jpeg/1791104440/profiles/marc-rousavy-224d99b0-61da-4fd8-a7e2-57ecadc6ac75.png)

Founder and CEO of Margelo, a high-end app development company working with clients like Facebook, Red Bull, Coinbase and Shopify. Software developer and designer from Austria with experience at startups in Paris, San Francisco, and Vienna.

## I'm Evan Bacon

A talk by Evan Bacon... about Evan Bacon or something like that? Don't miss it!

![](/img/72x72/jpeg/1791104440/profiles/evan-bacon-a5051a26-5ea8-4da3-954d-7b390ee947da.png)

Creator of Expo Router at Expo.
